intervals.quote: saw first light on its giant mosaic camera in 1998 and entered routine operations in 2000

placements.note: Start is the SDSS first-light year (1998); the telescope was built in the 1990s (apo.nmsu.edu).
placements.quote: The SDSS uses a dedicated 2.5-m f/5 modified Ritchey-Chrétien altitude-azimuth telescope located at Apache Point Observatory

diameter.quote: The SDSS uses a dedicated 2.5-m f/5 modified Ritchey-Chrétien altitude-azimuth telescope

summary.plain: The dedicated 2.5-metre telescope at Apache Point, New Mexico, with a very wide 3-degree field of view, used for every phase of the Sloan Digital Sky Survey.
summary.technical: 2.5-m f/5 modified Ritchey-Chrétien alt-az telescope with a 1.08 m secondary and two corrector lenses giving a 3-degree distortion-free field; fibre-fed spectrographs since the late 2000s.

technology.quote: A 1.08 m secondary mirror and two corrector lenses result in a 3° distortion-free field of view.
technology.value: 2.5-m f/5 modified Ritchey-Chrétien altitude-azimuth telescope with a 3-degree distortion-free field of view.
